Welcome to Exotic Pet Microscope—a science-based channel exploring the hidden biology and behavior of exotic pets.
From leopard geckos and snakes to spiders and frogs, we explain how these remarkable animals eat, move, communicate, adapt, and survive. You’ll also learn practical care principles, common beginner mistakes, and what your pet’s behavior may actually mean.
New Shorts and in-depth videos exploring exotic animal biology and care.
Understand the animal. Improve the care.
Educational content only. For medical concerns, consult a qualified exotic-animal veterinarian.
